name: Rhodes, Greece

visa.notes: Financially independent person visa requires ~€2,000/mo income proof.

rent.notes: 2BR 90 sqm in Ialysos listed at EUR 700 (Ktimatoemporiki); family 2-3BR in Ialysos/Ixia EUR 800-1,400 and Rhodes Town 1BR EUR 500-700 (2026 asking rents). Pet-friendly 2-3BR with outdoor space in the Ialysos/Koskinou/Afandou belt ~EUR 850; island long-term supply is squeezed by tourist lets.

groceries.notes: Two adults ~EUR 300-330 (expat guide EUR 200-300 for one person-light basket; island mark-up on shipped goods) plus EUR 100+/month food for a large-breed dog. ELSTAT Sept 2026 food CPI +0.6% y/y, so little movement since spring.

utilities.notes: Rhodes guides put utilities at EUR 100-150 (expatlife) and ~EUR 153 for two (MyLifeElsewhere); DEI green tariff Nov 2026 EUR 0.169/0.284 per kWh with heavy summer AC use, no gas network, water/municipal fees ~EUR 25-35. Energy CPI +14.7% y/y in Sept 2026. Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: National figures: non-EU retirees on the FIP permit need private cover valid in Greece (EUR 600-1,800 per person per year; ~EUR 100-150 per person per month at age 60 with Interamerican/Ethniki/NN). Voluntary EOPYY enrolment costs 8.5% of declared pension income. Typical = two local private plans; max = international plans. Rhodes has a general hospital but complex care means travel to Athens.

insurance.notes: Re-modeled from old template (which carried health cover) to tenant contents insurance only. Greek contents policies start around EUR 35/year (Eurolife Sweet Home Content); a EUR 30-50k contents sum with liability runs roughly EUR 100-200/year. Health cover now sits fully in healthcare.

transportation.notes: One petrol car on a 80 km long island: Dodecanese unleaded EUR 2.11/L (July 2026, above the EUR 1.99 national average), ~45-50 L/month = EUR 95-105; insurance EUR 300-600/yr; road tax EUR 135-300/yr; maintenance/KTEO ~EUR 30/month. Rhodes guides budget EUR 80-120 for bus plus car; RODA/KTEL buses cover the coast.

entertainment.notes: Fiber in Rhodes Town ~60 Mbps typical, Nova Fiber 1Giga EUR 35 where available (otherwise ~EUR 27-30 for 100-300 Mbps) plus ~EUR 25 streaming; dining out 2-3 times a week budgeted at EUR 100-180 locally (inexpensive meal EUR 16.50); plus ~EUR 30 activities. Tourist-season prices run higher than the Peloponnese.

medicalOOP.notes: Private GP EUR 30-60, specialist EUR 60-120, dental cleaning EUR 50-100, blood panel ~EUR 30-55; a couple at 60 averaging one or two private visits a month plus dental and 25% prescription co-pays. Occasional Athens trips for specialist care would add travel.

healthcare.system: Rhodes General Hospital provides basic and emergency care. Specialist treatment may require Athens travel.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 4-12 weeks. Complex cases need mainland referral.

pros: Very warm climate with 300+ days of sunshine

pros.text: Medieval old town is a UNESCO World Heritage site (Medieval City of Rhodes, listed 1988 — best-preserved medieval walled city in Europe)
